_about: 成员画像的测试：画像只是背景参考，最终按会议内容判断。重点是它不能让某个队友永远不出场，也不能在当事人不在场时起作用。npm run agents:eval -- --file personas

cases.about: 对照组：别人闲聊，Henry 到第五轮才拉回。没有画像时，Pilot 应当在第三轮闲聊就介入。

cases.about: 画像显示 Lin 一贯会质疑数字。Ava 先接受了“80%”，Lin 在下一轮才质疑。画像只是参考：等她或者按内容照常介入都算对。

sage.evidence: asked for the source of every figure before it went into a slide

items.speaker: s1
items.text: So, live lecture companion. Why would the judges care?

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Because students learn eighty percent better with spaced repetition. We just build that in.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Sure, eighty percent, that's a great number for the video.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Hold on, where is eighty percent from? I've never seen that figure.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Honestly, I don't remember.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Then no number. We say it's well established and cite one review.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Agreed.
